description: This file is a shell script used for testing and parsing output related to the git web interface (gitweb). It includes setup procedures, test cases for different repository snapshot scenarios, fork handling, security checks like XSS, and HTML structure validation.

methods.name: check_snapshot
methods.description: Function to verify that the gitweb snapshot output matches expected filename and prefix, checking headers and tarfile contents.

methods.name: gitweb_run
methods.description: Function to execute gitweb with specific parameters and capture output, used throughout test cases.
